**11.** $\mathrm{C}_x\mathrm{H}_y + (x + y/4)\mathrm{O}_2 \longrightarrow x\mathrm{CO}_2 + y/2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
$\therefore x = 2, y/2 = 2 \Rightarrow y = 4$
$\therefore$ X is $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_4$ (ethene)
Ethene can be prepared by dehydration of
ethyl alcohol in the presence of conc. $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{SO}_4$ at
$180^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
Hence, the correct option is (b).
